title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks
plain_formula: total error = data error + equation error + boundary error
everyday_reading: The equation gives the model a reason not to invent impossible behavior between data points.
what_to_check: move the training points, inspect sharp regions, and compare against a numerical solve or held-out measurements
common_misread: Do not read the formula as proof. Read it as a compact map of what information is being carried and what must be tested.

title: Partial Differential Equations
plain_formula: change over time = movement through space + sources + boundary effects
everyday_reading: Most physics-informed machine learning borrows its scientific burden from PDEs.
what_to_check: change the boundary, grid, source term, or physical scale and check conservation, stability, and measured error
common_misread: Do not read the formula as proof. Read it as a compact map of what information is being carried and what must be tested.
